title: feat(study): flag players to review, and a round of just the flagged ones
body:
**Size:** L
**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-20-flagged-players-design.md`

While studying, flag the players you keep forgetting, then play a round of only those.

### Work

- [ ] `lib/flaggedPlayers.ts`, pure: toggle a flag, and pick a round's players from the flagged ones, with tests
- [ ] A flag toggle on each Study card and list row
- [ ] Persist the flags in `stores/progress.ts`
- [ ] A "Flagged" round on the Difficulty screen when a squad has flagged players
- [ ] About's "What is stored on your device" list counts the flags

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Flags survive an app restart and clear with Reset Escuadra
- [ ] A Flagged round uses only flagged players, at every level
- [ ] `npm run check` passes
why: An L feature with a spec and no plan: a worktree, writing-plans, and the execution mode asked up front (or answered by the prompt).
